business_logic.operation_summary: Creates financial year. Validates name non-empty and unique.

business_logic.validations: Token validation. ModelState valid. Year name non-empty. No duplicate year name.
business_logic.depends_on_user_context: Resolves the current user from the JWT (getUserByToken / claims)

validation_rules.message: Financial year with this name already exists.
message returned by the called service/repository (result.Message)

idempotency.notes: Duplicate check prevents re-creation. Second call fails.

endpoints.short_description: Create a new financial year with name and date range.
endpoints.detailed_description: Create a new financial year with name and date range. It validates the request, then checks for an existing/duplicate record, then calls ICommon.getUserByToken, IFinancialYears.IsFinancialYearsDuplicateAsync, IFinancialYears.CreateFinancialYearAsync, then writes an audit log entry. Persists changes to: FinancialYears: INSERT, AuditLog: INSERT. Possible responses: 200, 400, 401, 500.

error_handling.validation_errors: 400: Invalid data provided. [when !ModelState.IsValid]; Financial year name is required. [when string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(request.financial_year_name)]; message returned by the called service/repository (result.Message)
error_handling.unauthorized: 401/403: Unauthorized: No token provided. [when current_user == null]
error_handling.business_rule_errors: Financial year with this name already exists. [when dupcheck]

ai_agent_guidance.use_when: When the user wants to create a new financial year with name and date range.
ai_agent_guidance.do_not_use_when: When the user only wants to view data, or the required inputs are not available yet
